name: Facundo Sharry
about: I am in the process of finishing my Computer Science degree and I've been working in web development for 3 years now. I design and implement full-stack systems — with an emphasis on performance, testability, and maintainability.
about2:
I have been studying Computer Science at the National University of Córdoba, Argentina since 2021. Throughout my studies I have built a solid foundation in areas such as algorithms, data structures, software development, and database management, enabling me to apply analytical thinking and problem-solving to real-world challenges.

In 2023 I began working as a full-stack developer at the university's College of Odontology. I am passionate about digitalization and reducing bureaucracy; among other contributions, I helped develop a dental medical records system, bringing many solutions to our users and clients.

Some technologies I have worked with:

experiencias.compania: College of Odontology - National University of Cordoba
descripcion: Developed and maintained internal healthcare and administrative systems, including a dental medical records platform and structured postulation workflows, replacing manual Excel- and form-based processes.
Rebuilt and modernized Human Resources and appointment scheduling systems, leading analysis and documentation (SRS) and adapting institutional requirements to existing open-source solutions.
Contributed to infrastructure and team processes through basic system administration, workflow standardization (Git/GitHub, Jira), and institution-wide technical support.

projects.descripcion: Board game The Switcher, it consists of a 6x6 board made with squares of random colors that can be moved with 'movement cards', the objective is to switch the colors to match a target pattern till you complete your targets cards. Made in React for the frontend and FastAPI for the backend. It features local and online multiplayer modes, with real-time gameplay using WebSockets.
NyanCat animation made in assembly(armv8) and reproduced in a emulator of an ARM architecture machine with Qemu on a 640x480 pixels screen. It uses double buffering to avoid flickering.
